{"consolidated_memory":"## Partial Upload Issue in storage/blob/uploader.rs — Four Separate Incidents

**Component:** storage/blob/uploader.rs (Rust, storage side)
**Common Problem Signature:** Final part of upload never gets acknowledged
**Common Reproduction:** Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
**Covering Test:** Module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs

---

### Incident 1: [2026-07-15]
**Trigger:** Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
**Root Cause:** Error swallowed by a bare except handler
**Fix:** Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
**PR:** #1742 on branch fix/partial-upload-1
**Outcome:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 65 days running

### Incident 2: [2026-07-30]
**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
**Root Cause:** Serializer dropping fields it did not know about
**Fix:** Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
**PR:** #2653 on branch fix/partial-upload-2
**Outcome:** Cold start dropped 29 percent, to 236 ms

### Incident 3: [2026-08-11]
**Trigger:** Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
**Root Cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file
**Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
**PR:** #2935 on branch fix/partial-upload-3
**Outcome:** Throughput rose 46 percent, to 380 requests per second

### Incident 4: [2026-08-27]
**Trigger:** Payloads above roughly two megabytes
**Root Cause:** Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
**Fix:** Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
**PR:** #3261 on branch fix/partial-upload-4
**Outcome:** Error rate dropped from 2.5 percent to under 7 per ten thousand"}
